posts: The best style rarely looks like it is trying very hard. It lets one detail do the talking.
A coat can be simple. Then the sleeve, the watch, or the way a cuff is folded changes the whole sentence.
That is why style usually whispers: the eye notices the detail before the mind names it.
Quick test: what do you notice first in someone's style—shoes, watch, bag, or colors?
text_posts.instructions: Posts 2 and 3 can run as a connected mini-thread; publish Posts 1 and 4 separately across Threads and X. Space them across the configured text slots.

checklist: Watch both MP4 masters and confirm all six rhythm-aligned cuts feel intentional.
Inspect the cover and contact sheet; confirm text is readable and no logos dominate the frame.
Confirm Pexels pages, creators, license evidence, and SHA-256 hashes in manifest.json.
Confirm 1080 x 1920, H.264, 17-second duration, and audio-stream checks passed.
Listen for clean tactile ASMR cues without clipping, harsh impacts, or distracting melody.
Confirm there is no watermark, false personal-filming claim, or unlicensed external audio.
Verify caption, CTA, comma-separated tags, cover, date, time zone, and preview before scheduling.
